result.stdout:
================================================================================
  Automation Sandbox - Self-Healing CLI
  (language/platform-agnostic locator healing: JSON in, JSON out)
================================================================================

Usage:
  automation-sandbox-heal --expected <stale-element.json> --tree <live-tree.json> [--profile balanced|conservative|aggressive]

--expected   A single UiElementInfo JSON object: the stale/broken locator's last known snapshot.
--tree       A UiElementInfo JSON tree: a freshly captured snapshot of the live application.
--profile    Threshold profile (default: balanced). See SimilarityWeights.FromProfile.

Both JSON inputs must be shaped like UiTreeSerializer.ToJson's output - produce this
from any language or tool; no C# or FlaUI/Playwright .NET dependency is needed to call this.

Prints a HealResult as JSON to stdout. Exit code 0 means IsConfident (safe to accept
Matched); non-zero (1) means not confident - do not auto-accept Matched; 2 means an error
(bad input, missing file) occurred before a decision could be made.
